controls.context_budget: Model E passes four source passages. Model F profiles use the per-medium budgets in model_f_context.budget. Utilization is reported and is not a quality metric.
controls.decoding: temperature 0.7, top_p 0.9, repetition penalty 1.15, seed base 42, as compare_adapters records them.
controls.generator: Frozen Relabel adapter. Do not change the adapter between arms.
controls.held_out: Do not read the corpus validation or test split to choose a profile, a prompt, or a budget.
controls.pairing: Compare arms on the same question_id and medium. Report a paired difference and a bootstrap interval. Do not average those differences into one rank.
controls.questions: Same question ids on every arm. Development questions are the pilot and graph-relationship review files. The 30-topic gold file is a generation development set, not the corpus test split.
controls.retrieval_difference: Dense k counts passages. LightRAG top_k counts entities or relationships, and chunk_top_k counts chunks. Both arms then keep an evidence budget of four passages. Those ranks are not the same score.
